title: THE EVANGELISTIC ZEAL OF PRAYER WARRIOR DAVID BRAINERD

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Therefore, my beloved brethren, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not in vain in the Lord." - 1 Corinthians 15:58

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Though David Brainerd lived for only 29 years, his personal diary entries left an indelible mark on church history. It was the diary of this great prayer warrior that ignited a holy, zealous fire within many mighty men of God, such as John Wesley, David Livingstone, and Henry Martyn.
Amidst the agony and weakness of tuberculosis, he never gave up his burning passion for the Gospel. No matter how short our lives may be, every prayer and labor we offer for the Lord will bear eternal fruit. Keeping our spiritual fervor alive without ever diminishing is our vital duty.
Just as a candle melts itself away to give light, this young man, David Brainerd, poured out his life in prayer and gave himself completely. The book titled "40 Days with David Brainerd", abridged by Richard A. Hasler, is exceptionally wonderful and a must-read for this generation of Christians.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Expect great things from God; attempt great things for God." -  William Carey

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving Heavenly Father, impart to us the same spirit of prayer and evangelistic zeal that You revealed in the life of David Brainerd. We yield ourselves into Your hands as fragile vessels. Help us to shine as burning lamps for Your kingdom every single day of our lives. In Jesus' name, we pray. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Never be discouraged by your weaknesses. God is able to do great things through your brief lifespan or simple circumstances. Surrender yourself completely into God's hands today, and He will use you as a mighty instrument for the Gospel.
